subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures that include details for full verbose, heartbeat, and timed-out cron runs be suppressed before mutating-warning handling, or should those visible detail warnings remain the contract?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface those detail warnings, while this PR claims they should always be hidden; automation should not choose that user-visible warning policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve detail warnings and narrow the fix
options.body: Keep the current full-verbose, heartbeat, cron, and mutating safety behavior, then narrow or replace this PR so it does not hide those cases by accident.

options.title: Adopt suppress-all exec-like policy
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update focused tests to show that detail-mode exec-like failures are intentionally hidden.

options.title: Pause pending live proof
options.body: Keep the PR open while asking for redacted live output that demonstrates the exact warning behavior maintainers want to change.

recommendation.title: Preserve detail warnings and narrow the fix
recommendation.body: Keep the current full-verbose, heartbeat, cron, and mutating safety behavior, then narrow or replace this PR so it does not hide those cases by accident.
